notes.title: Citadale - The Legends Trilogy Official Soundtrack Release
notes.content:
The Citadale - The Legends Trilogy Soundtrack contains all 32 tracks from all three games in full chiptune glory. Composed by Ezekiel Rage and Trevor Lentz it features over an hour of music.
Everyone who bought Citadale - The Legends Trilogy on Steam can now download the entire soundtrack for free.

notes.title: Fight the virus, stay at home SALE
notes.content:
Due to the recent outbreaks of Covid-19 most of us have been urged to stay at home to prevent further spread of the virus. And because staying at home is more fun if you can play videogames, I decided to put ALL of my games on sale for 50% off.

Stay at home, stop the virus! And enjoy gaming while you save lives :)

notes.title: Giveaway!
notes.content:
As huge fans of Castlevania, we are very happy to see it back with Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon! 

In order to celebrate the successful release of Bloodstained: Curse of the Moon, we are giving away 5 keys for Citadale: The Legends Trilogy to people commenting this Steam announce.

May 8Bit Vampire slaying never die!

Follow us on Twitter: https://twitter.com/RealEzekielRage

Bloodstained is available here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/838310/Bloodstained_Curse_of_the_Moon/

notes.title: New update!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, a new update for the game has just been released. 

What's new?
- Added a double check for boss rooms in the second Chapter
- Tweaked enemy placement even further
- Finetuned the hit detection even more
- Some graphical upgrades in the backgrounds

notes.title: Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Citadale - The Legends Trilogy has been recently updated. 

Changelog:
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug in keyboard mode that stopped a cutscene
[*]Added save states: Press F1 or the left analog stick to save a state and press F2 or the right analog stick to load a savestate. 
[i]Note: Savestates are universal so it's ONE savestate for all three chapters![/i][/list]
